verdict.rationale: Sierra's Agent SDK and Channels docs confirm one agent can be built once and deployed across chat, phone, email, SMS, and messaging (sierra-docs-3), and it even publishes to ChatGPT (sierra-docs-17), showing broad omnichannel intent. However, the evidence never explicitly names Slack, WhatsApp, or social media as supported channels, so the specific channels the story calls out are not directly confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming Slack, WhatsApp, and social media as supported channels, plus independent/hands-on confirmation of multi-channel parity.
